ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens: dark green curly and flat spinach-like leaves with some reddish-purple tinged small leaves, lightly dressed-looking with slight sheen, loosely piled across upper-left and center of plate, covering roughly 35% of plate area, about 5 cm tall in mound | 110
ITEM 2 | Shredded orange-red carrot strands scattered among the greens, thin, about 3-4 cm long, bright orange, few pieces | 5
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown breaded or crumbed nugget-like pieces, four to five elongated chunks about 4-5 cm long and 2 cm wide, slightly crisp fried exterior with darker browned edges, firm, lying in a cluster at lower-center of plate | 120
ITEM 4 | Broccoli florets, dark green with bushy tops, small cluster about 6 cm across, moist-looking, sitting between the nuggets and the pizza-like slice | 40
ITEM 5 | Wedge of baked cheese slice with golden-brown blistered top and orange-red tomato-sauce patches visible, about 12 cm long and 7 cm wide, roughly 2.5 cm thick, firm and slightly oily sheen at surface, sitting at right side of plate | 210
